title: The Sun Is a Star
text: One morning {{name}} sat in class. The teacher had a big picture of the sun. "The sun is a star," the teacher said. {{name}} was very curious. The sun looked so big and bright. But the stars at night looked tiny. "Why are the stars so small?" {{name}} asked. "They are very far away," the teacher said. "The sun is near. That is why it is big." {{name}} smiled and felt happy. The teacher gave {{name}} a gold star. {{name}} was very glad. After school {{name}} looked up at the sun. It was warm and yellow. At night {{name}} saw many little stars. They were suns too, but far away. {{name}} drew a big yellow sun on a card. "You are my star," {{name}} said. {{name}} put the card on the wall. The sun was a new friend now. Every day {{name}} looked up and smiled.

questions.prompt: What did the teacher say the sun is?
Why are the other stars so small?
What did {{name}} draw on a card?

summary: 主角在课堂上得知太阳其实是一颗星星,因好奇而提问,老师解释其他星星因离得远才显得小;主角白天看太阳、夜里看星星,明白星星也是太阳,最后画下太阳贴在墙上,把太阳当成了新朋友。
